name: portoevents
description: Agregador de eventos do Porto com scraping e armazenamento em JSON

scripts.svc:stop: bash -lc 'pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:3000); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then kill $pids && echo "Servico parado (PID: $pids)"; else echo "Servico ja estava parado"; fi'
scripts.svc:status: bash -lc 'curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/api/health >/dev/null && echo "Servico online" || echo "Servico offline"'
